ul.li:
When the Disqualifications/Disentitlements (M161) transaction opens, complete the following fields:
Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Action: Select X - Rescind .
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select B - Non-fraud - Availability, capability .
Message: Select 4 - An overpayment resulted due to an indefinite disentitlement .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select C - Yes .

step.cmd: Determine if it is an initial, a renewal or a continuing claim:

ul.li: If it is an initial claim, calculate the claim and go to step 19. calculate the claim
If it is a renewal claim, renew the claim and go to step 19. renew the claim
If it is a continuing claim, go to step 19.

Fact-find with the representative to obtain the claimant’s reports for the period up to and including the day of the client’s death.

ul.li: If the representative was contacted, go to step 22.
If the representative was not contacted and did not reply to the letter, go to step 29.
